0022600007.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder are 1-0 and 1st in the Northwest and the West after winning their road game, and this is their second game of the season. Denver has not played a 2026-27 game yet, and the season series is still open this year, though the Thunder won the 2025-26 series 3-1 and the Nuggets beat them 127-107 in Denver on April 10, 2026. Otega Oweh is out for the Thunder with Achilles surgery recovery, while Nikola Topic (back surgery) and Thomas Sorber (knee surgery) are day-to-day and game-time decisions. For Denver, Julian Strawther is out with a knee sprain and Spencer Jones is day-to-day with a hamstring injury and is also a game-time decision.
